jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role
You will join a busy service desk supporting 2,000 users across three offices. Day to day you will troubleshoot hardware and software issues, manage tickets in ServiceNow, and keep the knowledge base current.

What you'll need
- 5+ years of help desk or desktop support experience
- Active Directory and Microsoft 365 administration
- Strong customer service and clear written communication
- Comfort with Windows 10/11 imaging and Intune

Nice to have
- CompTIA A+ or Network+
- ITIL Foundation
- Some PowerShell scripting

We offer a hybrid schedule and a learning budget. You will excel in a fast-moving team and grow with us.
